description: R3 replication of e01 on a DIFFERENT attention shape. Single variable changed vs Qwen3-4B: head_dim 64 instead of 128, GQA ratio held at 4:1. If the large-bucket flatness gradient is an RPA tiling effect it should move; if it is universal it should not.
note_occupancy: Occupancy is bounded to (0.5, 1.0] by the power-of-two ladder; B/2 is a bucket edge. Run e01 on the DEFAULT ladder — gap ladders give a far narrower range (gap=512 at B=4096 spans only 0.875-1.0).
